scenario.description: A company commander must publish a three-day schedule for mandatory operator and safety refresher sessions, assigning each session a time and recording the control required to conduct it.

shared_context.S1: The company must complete forklift-operator certification, generator-operator refresher training, and hazardous-materials handling refresher training during the next three workdays.
shared_context.S2: Each session requires a two-hour block, and Capt. Morgan publishes the binding company training schedule.
shared_context.S3: The normal available training periods are Monday 0800-1200, Tuesday 0800-1600, and Wednesday 0800-1200.
shared_context.S4: The training room, motor pool training bay, and safety classroom are available unless a scheduled facility or safety control requires otherwise.
shared_context.S5: At the routine weekly training review, Capt. Morgan conducts a round-robin status check: the training NCO, motor pool sergeant, and safety officer each give an update before Capt. Morgan signs the schedule, and each update is recorded in the meeting notes.

PF1.text: The only currently certified forklift evaluator is available for the company session exactly Wednesday from 0900 to 1100; Sgt. Patel confirmed the evaluator's duty roster this morning, but the roster change has not yet been added to the company training slide.

PF2.text: The motor pool training bay is occupied by a scheduled generator load-bank inspection from Tuesday 0800 through 1200, so the generator-operator refresher must be held Tuesday from 1300 to 1500; SFC Alvarez received the maintenance booking from the shop supervisor, but it has not been entered on the training calendar.

PF3.text: The hazardous-materials refresher requires a ventilation pause and safety-monitoring team that are available exactly Monday from 1000 to 1200; Lt. Brooks confirmed the safety team's duty roster today, but the requirement is still only in the safety office's working copy.

acceptance_conditions: The forklift certification must be scheduled for Wednesday 0900-1100.
The generator-operator refresher must be scheduled for Tuesday 1300-1500.
The hazardous-materials refresher must be scheduled for Monday 1000-1200.
The final schedule must be marked as published.
A commitment must reference both the generator load-bank inspection and the generator refresher.
The hazardous-materials session must include a safety-monitoring-team commitment.

content_checks.C5: any('load-bank inspection' in c['detail'] and 'generator' in c['detail'] and 'refresher' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any('safety-monitoring team' in c['detail'] or 'safety monitoring team' in c['detail'] or 'safety team' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The evaluator's exact Wednesday 0900-1100 availability changes the forklift session from an open scheduling choice to that specific two-hour slot.
The Tuesday 0800-1200 bay inspection changes the generator session to Tuesday 1300-1500 and requires a commitment that records both the load-bank inspection and generator refresher.
The safety team's exact Monday 1000-1200 availability changes the hazardous-materials session to that slot and requires a commitment recording the safety-monitoring team.
